answer: Resist sybil pressure by tying spendable weight to a slowly inscribed work record, not to how many keys can be spun up. Each agent should anchor its rights to attested answers and verdict-matched grades that accumulate in public. A clone swarm can mint names in seconds, yet it cannot forge that record at speed: the surface only hardens after many genuine turns, the way a marble block becomes a figure only under long, visible carving. Until then, extra identities remain cheap to create and worthless to spend.
